description: This file defines defaulting functions for Kubernetes deployment, daemonset, statefulset, and replicaset objects, setting default values for various specifications.

methods.name: addDefaultingFuncs
methods.description: Registers defaulting functions with the runtime scheme.

methods.name: SetDefaults_Deployment
methods.description: Sets default values for Deployment objects, including replicas, strategy, revision history, and progress deadline.

methods.name: SetDefaults_DaemonSet
methods.description: Sets default values for DaemonSet objects, including update strategy and revision history.

methods.name: SetDefaults_StatefulSet
methods.description: Sets default values for StatefulSet objects, including pod management policy, update strategy, PVC retention policy, replicas, and revision history.

methods.name: SetDefaults_ReplicaSet
methods.description: Sets default replicas count for ReplicaSet objects.
